after.topFix: Open with a real, tailored profit tree instead of a list of areas: restate the objective, then split profit into revenue (price × traffic × items per visit) and costs (COGS, labor, overhead/rent), and say which branch you'd test first and why. In this case that was costs, since revenue grew while margin fell. Your later analysis was excellent, but freezing at the structuring stage is what an interviewer remembers. Second, compute any figure before quoting it.
